name: TJpgDec
description: ChaN's Tiny JPEG Decompressor (vendored). Baseline-JPEG decode engine for the EPUB image path; uses a small caller-supplied work pool instead of JPEGDEC's ~20 KB struct. Configured for grayscale output (JD_FORMAT=2) with DCT scaling. Source from http://elm-chan.org/fsw/tjpgd/ (R0.03); modified from upstream only in tjpgdcnf.h (config + JD_FASTPATH macro) and the JD_FASTPATH annotations on the hot decode functions in tjpgd.c.
